loss: Native896 balanced BCE + .5 Dice on sigmoid(20*(CAM-mean historical brightness thresholds)); alpha anchor + TV regularization
selection: 80/160/240/320 steps; mean calibration micro-IoU over three 1-shot support choices with per-support thresholds; earlier step wins ties
scope: Known-PV supervised development pilot: 22 training masks, 12 calibration masks, 3 reserved independent 1-shot supports, 24 previously observed query images
